== English Reflections III comparison ==
The original Reflections III Defensive Shield has no Grabber icon. The Advanced Rulebook names it as a Grabber. Its E-marked full face shows the icon, as do the current full face and D-E1 slip. The stacking and Force cost clauses agree across both faces. The separate Coruscant Effect has its own comparison.
